sources.title: Industry Statistics — fact sheet, table "Global airline industry", updated 6/2026
sources.publisher: International Air Transport Association, Sustainability and Economics
sources.note: read as a PDF and extracted with pdftotext. The rows used here are O-D passengers, million (4,343 forecast for 2026) and Passenger, USD billion (839 forecast for 2026). The fact sheet publishes no average-fare line; the figure derived from those two rows is marked as this project's arithmetic wherever it appears.

sources.title: The Equal Earth map projection
sources.publisher: Savric B, Patterson T, Jenny B. International Journal of Geographical Information Science 2019;33(3):454-465, published online 7 August 2018, doi:10.1080/13658816.2018.1504949
sources.note: the publisher's page returned HTTP 403; the citation and the description of the projection as an equal-area pseudocylindrical world projection were read on the encyclopedia article registered as s:wp-equal-earth. The projection's coefficients are implemented in tools/worldmap.py.
